title: 情報工学基礎演習
subtitle: Computer Programming Practice
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn basic management and operational skills for computer systems.
(2) Acquire various C programming skills on Linux command line.
(3) Acquire Linux environment construction and operation technology.
advice:
This is a basic C programming course. We will cover the following materials:

1. Installing virtual machines and Linux
2. Linux command exercises
3. Programming with the basic data types and array
4. Standard input/output stream
5. Programming with the function definitions and its calls
6. Recursive function call
7. Programming with the structure and pointer
8. String processing
9. File input/output processing
10. Programming with the bitwise logical operators

Students are expected to bring their textbook, notebook PC, and other necessary materials to every class.
Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.

lessons.content:
Basic Linux Operations 1
Terminal and Shell
Basic commands (cat, ls, cd, pwd, mkdir, rm, etc
.)
Manual commands (man)
How to use the editor
How to call various processing systems (python,
java, rust, c, c++)

Basic Linux Operations 2
Commands for files and directories
Standard input, standard output, and standard er
ror output
Redirects and pipes
Process management commands

Basic Linux Operations 3
Commands for files and directories
Standard input, standard output, and standard er
ror output
Redirects and pipes
Process management commands

Basic Linux Operations 4
Commands for files and directories
Standard input, standard output, and standard er
ror output
Redirects and pipes
Process management commands

How to make C programs (preprocessor, compiler,
assembler, linker, library)

C Language Basics 1
Assembly language has no data types
Data types, arrays, terminal I/O
Data types (char, int, float, double, size_t, in
t8_t uint8_t, int32_t, uint32_t) and arrays
Input/output using printf(), scanf(), getchar(),
 putchar()
Address operators
Sizeof operator
Character codes

C Language Basics 2
Operators and Control Syntax, Constant Macros
Ternary operators, sizeof()
if, while, for, do-while, switch-case, continue,
 break
Define
Sleep sleep(), usleep()　
Numerical calculations (moving averages, integra
ls...)
State machine
Random numbers, seeds

C Language Basics 3
User function definition and invocation, scope,
stack area, commonly used standard functions
Static modifiers
Atoi, atof, strlen, fgets
Recursive calls

C Language Applications 2
Pointers, dynamic allocation of memory, command
line arguments
malloc(), free()

C Language Applications 4
File operations (stream I/O), reading and writin
g text and binary files -- .
FILE*, stdin, stdout
fopen, fclose, fread, fwrite, fprintf, fprintf,
fprintf, fprintf, fprintf, fprintf, fprintf, fpr
intf, fprintf

C Language Applications 5
C: Bitwise Operators

3. Programming with the basic data types and array
4. Standard input/output stream
5. Programming with the function definitions and its calls

7. Programming with the structure and pointer
8. String processing
9. File input/output processing
